context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase S4 Tasks · Forms · Compliance fully tested and working. Backend tests cover: TASKS (CRUD, recurring daily/weekly, materialise idempotent, complete with photo verification, uncomplete), FORMS (templates CRUD, all 9 field kinds validated, submissions with required field validation), COMPLIANCE (certs CRUD, severity banding auto-computed, tracker endpoint with buckets and missing_staff). Frontend verified: Operations tab visible in Staffing console, 3 sub-tabs (Tasks & Checklists, Forms, Compliance) with pill toggle, all buttons and panels working.

backend: GET /api/staffing/tasks - lists tasks for org, managers see all, staff see own assignments + unassigned
GET /api/staffing/tasks?date=YYYY-MM-DD - includes recurring daily AND weekly tasks matching weekday
POST /api/staffing/tasks - validates kind in {one_off, shift_linked, opening, closing, recurring}
POST /api/staffing/tasks - rejects recurring without recurrence, rejects weekly without weekdays
POST /api/staffing/tasks/{id}/complete - sets status=completed, rejects 400 when requires_photo=true and photo_url missing
POST /api/staffing/tasks/materialise - generates one-off instances of recurring templates, idempotent
GET /api/staffing/forms/templates - lists templates, non-managers see only matching audience_role
POST /api/staffing/forms/templates - validates field kinds in {text, long_text, number, select, multiselect, checkbox, date, signature, photo}
POST /api/staffing/forms/templates/{id}/submit - validates required fields, persists template_name_snapshot
GET /api/staffing/forms/submissions - returns all (manager) or just own (staff)
POST /api/staffing/compliance/certs - creates cert with severity band auto-computed
GET /api/staffing/compliance/certs - lists certs scoped to caller
PATCH /api/staffing/compliance/certs/{id} - updates expires_at and re-bands severity
GET /api/staffing/compliance/tracker - groups certs by band, counts each, lists missing_staff
Severity banding: expired (past), expiring_30 (0-30d), expiring_90 (30-90d), ok (>90d), unknown (no expiry)
frontend: Operations tab visible in Staffing console after Comms Hub tab
3 sub-tabs (Tasks & Checklists, Forms, Compliance) selectable via pill toggle
Tasks panel: date picker filters list, New task button, Generate recurring button
Forms panel: New form button, Show submissions toggle
Compliance panel: severity summary chips per band, Add cert button, missing staff alert when missing_count > 0
